attack_type: Shadow-Free Loss-Threshold Membership Inference Attack (Yeom et al.)
interpretation: The federated champion exhibits a measured membership inference attack AUC of 0.5041 (95% CI: [0.4979, 0.5122]), indicating lower measured leakage under this attack compared to the centralized model (0.5840).
caveat: This empirical assessment measures lower empirical leakage under a shadow-free loss-threshold attack. It is NOT a formal mathematical differential privacy guarantee (e.g., (epsilon, delta)-DP). Formal differential privacy requires explicit gradient perturbation (DP-SGD) or secure aggregation protocols.
